name: jsreact
description: A collection of JavaScript utilities and tools for web development

scripts.copy:assets: cp -r src/images src/robots.txt src/sitemap.xml src/_headers src/_redirects dist/
scripts.build:js: swc src/scripts -d dist/scripts && swc src/components -d dist/components
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run create-dirs && npm run copy:html && npm run copy:assets && npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.dev: npm run clean && npm run create-dirs && (npm run dev:js & npm run dev:css & npm run dev:serve)
